steps.kql:
// PURPOSE: validate before you escalate. An unfamiliar location with MFA
// satisfied on a managed device is usually travel or a new ISP, not theft.
// This step also surfaces the account(s) to carry into steps 2-6.
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where IPAddress == "{{ip}}"
| extend Country     = tostring(column_ifexists("LocationDetails", dynamic(null)).countryOrRegion)
| extend City        = tostring(column_ifexists("LocationDetails", dynamic(null)).city)
| extend OS          = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceDetail", dynamic(null)).operatingSystem)
| extend Managed     = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceDetail", dynamic(null)).isManaged)
| extend Compliant   = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceDetail", dynamic(null)).isCompliant)
| extend MfaMethod   = tostring(column_ifexists("MfaDetail", dynamic(null)).authMethod)
| extend ASN         = tostring(column_ifexists("AutonomousSystemNumber", ""))
| extend CAStatus    = tostring(column_ifexists("ConditionalAccessStatus", ""))
| extend Risk        = tostring(column_ifexists("RiskLevelDuringSignIn", ""))
| extend Outcome     = iff(ResultType == "0", "Success", strcat("Fail ", ResultType))
| summarize Signins      = count(),
            Successes    = countif(ResultType == "0"),
            Failures     = countif(ResultType != "0"),
            FirstSeen    = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen     = max(TimeGenerated),
            Countries    = make_set(Country, 10),
            Cities       = make_set(City, 10),
            Apps         = make_set(AppDisplayName, 15),
            MfaMethods   = make_set(MfaMethod, 10),
            CAStatuses   = make_set(CAStatus, 10),
            RiskLevels   = make_set(Risk, 10),
            DeviceOS     = make_set(OS, 10),
            ManagedFlags = make_set(Managed, 5),
            Outcomes     = make_set(Outcome, 10)
    by UserPrincipalName, ASN
| order by Successes desc, Signins desc
//
// Look for: a SUCCESS where MfaMethods is empty or "Password", CAStatuses
//   is "notApplied", ManagedFlags has no "true", or RiskLevels is
//   medium/high. That combination is the compromise signal.
// Benign twin: MFA satisfied + managed/compliant device + a plausible
//   travel country = new ISP or roaming. Close it.
// Next: take UserPrincipalName from the top SUCCESS row into {{upn}} for
//   steps 2-6. If there were no successes at all, this is spray/stuffing
//   against you — pivot to the password-spray playbook instead.

steps.title: 2. Is this account's behaviour actually new? (trust-reduced novelty)
